title: Companies Who Reduce Headcount of Existing Employees While Leveraging JGI to Recruit New Workers
what_it_is: Companies Who Reduce Headcount of Existing Employees While Leveraging JGI to Recruit New Workers

sections.label: Jobs Growth Incentive eligibility rules
sections.summary: JGI gives up to 12 months salary support to qualifying hires from September 2020 to February 2021, requiring local workforce growth and higher-paid local jobs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: JGI was announced in August 2020 and will be provided to qualifying hires from September 2020 to February 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: Eligible local hires can attract salary support for up to 12 months.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: To be eligible for JGI, firms must achieve an increase in their local workforce size from the level in August 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: Hence, a firm with no net growth of jobs will not receive JGI payouts.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: A firm that initially increased its local headcount but subsequently reduced its local headcount below its original level would also stop receiving future JGI payouts.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: In addition, to ensure that the increase in local workforce is meaningful, it must be accompanied by an increase in the number of local employees in jobs that pay at least $1,400 in gross monthly wages.

sections.label: JGI payout reduction and anti-gaming
sections.summary: JGI payouts are reduced in proportion to existing employees who left after September 2020, and IRAS has an anti-gaming framework.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: In practice, firms would likely prefer to moderate their new hiring than have to deal with the risk of support being withdrawn.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: Hence, we take a practical approach, where a firm's JGI payout is reduced in proportion to the number of existing employees that left the firm after the scheme started in September 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: In addition, IRAS has put in place a robust anti-gaming framework to identify risks and prevent abuse.
